reviews.text: If you want your dog to die, take it to this veterinary clinic! This extremely expensive clinic with unprepared professionals almost killed my dog ​​by performing the wrong procedures. Don't take your dog to this clinic!
Incredible service, my dog ​​was hospitalized there. The highly qualified medical team sent me updates and videos every day.

I am extremely grateful to the entire Citta Vet team, Citta unit, for the care they gave my four-legged son, Bob. We were welcomed by everyone, from the reception staff to the assistants and the entire professional team. Besides providing the best possible quality of life for my baby, they offered affection, empathy, and connection. They were angels, always going above and beyond their duties. Thank you so much, Citta team ❤️
Amazing, attentive, competent, and caring with our pets. I entrust them with the life of the person I love most in the world.

A scam for gringos. :) I wanted to know the price of a certificate for an exit permit, but they redirected me to a "doctor" on WhatsApp. She quoted 800 reals. 800 reals for a certificate that requires you to fill in the doctor's details, the dog's details, vaccinations, sign, and stamp it. Does a "doctor" mean a PhD or a renowned scientist? $150 for a certificate. I haven't even seen prices like that in Europe. A scam.

Impeccable service! My dogs are always treated with great affection, care, and professionalism. It makes all the difference for us pet owners. You can feel the love for the animals in every detail. Gratitude to the entire team, I highly recommend them.

I am the owner of a mixed-breed dog undergoing cancer treatment, and before each chemotherapy session, a complete blood count is necessary for monitoring and verifying that everything is okay before proceeding with the treatment and starting the next chemotherapy session! Previously, I had the tests done at DOC Veterinary Hospital, where I always received excellent service. Because I live in the ABM region, near the Lúcio Costa bridge, I opted to have the tests done at Citta Vet due to its proximity!

However, on two consecutive occasions, the blood count results came back with incorrect and conflicting information. The first time, my name (owner) and the name of the referring veterinarian were misspelled. When I questioned this, the attendant Camila Ramos requested a correction and resent the results. Now, the second test came back with incorrect data regarding my pet's age and other information! When I questioned this, the attendant Hillary claimed that the laboratory service is outsourced and Citta Vet only forwards the report. The problem is that we contracted Citta Vet's services, and since they outsource the laboratory service, they are jointly responsible; they should at least verify the results. This casts serious doubt on the veracity of the presented results! Can we trust them? Are the results presented in the reports correct? It's very difficult to believe the information in the report; if even the header information is incorrect, imagine the parameters analyzed!

Furthermore, there is no automatic report delivery; if you don't request it, they don't send it. We collected the sample on Saturday, January 24th, 2026, and only today, January 29th, 2026, did they send the report after my request, and even then, it contained incorrect information! The laboratory to which Citta Vet outsourced the service was E+Lab!

I confess I don't trust the presented results!
Excellent
Excellent service!!! Dr. Elisa Maria is wonderful, with exemplary care!!! I felt very safe with my patient! 🙏🏻 …

Since I discovered Cittavet, I've never had to worry about who to entrust my dog ​​to again.
He arrived at this clinic with pancreatitis, gastritis, nephritis, constant vomiting, and seizures after years of treatment with professionals who didn't look carefully. After a while, between consultations and visits to the clinic, my Billy's health is completely different. He's already 15 years old. I discovered the clinic when he was 12, but today he's a completely different person. I thank all the professionals involved (Dani the neurologist, Paula the endocrinologist, Carolina Newman the ophthalmologist, Leonardo the dentist, they are spectacular!). Only thanks! Thank you so much for your work!

Congratulations to the Pet store for their excellent service. It was a Saturday night and the girl who helped me was a sweetheart. When I went back looking for a medication that my cat's vet had prescribed (a tablet), she came up with a second option in paste form, which was a godsend. We need more people like that! Excellent prices, wonderful service! 💖
I don't recommend them; they use interns as veterinarians, and I lost my dog.
Excellent!!!

My Babi has always received excellent care. Everyone on the grooming team is great. Dr. Camila was incredibly kind and attentive to my baby. When she needed to be hospitalized, she provided me with all the information, responded promptly regardless of the time, answered all my questions, and was very careful with us during that delicate moment. Everyone on the hospitalization team was also great. I don't have much to compare, but I found the prices quite reasonable for the level of care she received. I'm very grateful!
Excellent clinic! Great veterinarians, always attentive and caring.
The service is always excellent.
Initial response unprepared during an emergency, emergency team unprepared.

Best clinic in Rio de Janeiro for your pet. I would recommend it a thousand times if needed. Fair price, exceptional team, and excellent doctors who are extremely attentive and humane. Our pet received everything he needed at this clinic. Thank you for everything you did for our puppy. ♥️ A thousand stars

Excellent service! Recommended by the veterinarian who cared for my cat Pierre, who was once operated on at this unit for a tumor in his mouth, although they found more tumors spread throughout his throat, which didn't seem like a good prognosis. However, the biopsy showed a benign tumor. And he lived very well for another 8 years.

I recommend it!!!
Simply the best veterinary clinic there is. Dr. Rafael is UNIQUE!

Excellent service. I made a point of leaving a review here because I've been to several clinics and none compare to Cittavet. Whenever I needed 24-hour emergency care, I was promptly attended to. The hate speech below doesn't reflect reality, and it's clear it's the same person. Google shouldn't allow this.
